title: The Herald of Nothingness
notes: A new class: the Herald of Nothingness, Obliveion's herald. A gooey, thinking slime with a mouth full of tiny sharp teeth; pick its colour when you make one. Beat the Herald of Obliveion at Ascension -100 to unlock it.

Null: a new damage type. Nothing resists it and nothing can shred it, it carries no element (no reactions), and on a hero armor doesn't stop it (a block does). Its numbers are hollow. The Herald of Obliveion's erasures are Null now.

No gear: the Herald wears and wields nothing. It consumes gear (right-click it in your bag): the item is gone for good and its stats count at 50%. Its Teeth grow with your level or your best consumed weapon. Uniques and other good gear ask for a second right-click first.

Five trees. The Maw eats the elements on enemies and hits with them; every Maw, Hollow and Proclamation hit adds 25% of itself again as Null. The Unmaking is a pure Null caster that strips buffs, wards and whole affixes. The Hollow is the slime itself (Engulf, Seep, Re-form, Everything Becomes Nothing). The Proclamation silences, names and supports the party. Purity's True passives push the added Null to 100%.
Its class stat is Emptiness, and each tree has its route of Seeds, Boughs and three Crowns on the Tree of Life.
